messages:
Cara: Heads up — after we pushed the adaptive-window reconnect canary (v2) to eu-west we see ~2x event counts in the streaming console for affected tenants. Not sure if these are duplicates or new deliveries. :eyes:
Matt: Can you paste the console screenshot and the query you used?
Cara: screenshot -> https://img.redwood/snap/stream_counts.png
Cara: query was `sum(event_count) by (tenant, stream)` over last 5m, grouped by route.
Lia: I think telemetry might be dropping the `reconnect_window=adaptive` tag on the proxy for resumed sessions — our trace logs don't show the tag for some resume paths.
OpsBot: deploy bot: canary rollout started for service=stream-proxy, version=v2.14.2 @ 2025-11-07T17:01:05Z
Sanjay: My first suspicion: dedupe key changed when we switched to adaptive windowing. If the dedupe key uses (last_event_id, route_epoch) and route_epoch is changing on route swaps, resume tokens might no longer map to the same dedupe bucket -> duplicates.
Alex: Quick mitigation: re-enable strict dedupe on the proxy for 500ms after resume, independent of the adaptive window. We can add a fallback dedupe key.
Alex: patch snippet i tested locally:
```yaml
proxy.reconnect:
  dedupe_window_ms: 500
  dedupe_key: "resume_token||last_event_id"
  allow_adaptive_window: true
```
Matt: That could help short term. Also we should confirm whether billing/quotas are counting raw emitted events or deduped delivered events. Counting raw will overcharge customers.
Lia: Console currently shows "Events emitted" metric (what the runtime sends) and not "Events delivered (deduped)". We need a toggle or a new series. UX ask: add a "deduped" series so customers and billing align.
Cara: Important: some tenants with sticky routing have route epoch increments on small rollbacks, that might be the flip. If route affinity was rebalanced during canary, resume token namespace could have been remapped.
Sanjay: Agreed. Two action items: 1) quick proxy fallback to strict dedupe for resumes (Alex), 2) roll canary back or pause canary until we validate billing path (ops).
Alex: I'll open a PR for the fallback and post the link.
Matt: Ops: what's the canary weight now?
OpsBot: deploy bot: canary weight = 20% -> paused at 20%
Cara: Given the billing risk, I'd prefer rollback to previous stable for now. Can we do a rollback and then re-run a narrower canary with telemetry flags enabled?
Lia: Also add a telemetry counter `events_deduped` and tag `dedupe_strategy=proxy|runtime` so we can chart delivered vs emitted.
Sanjay: We'll need to update quota accounting to read `events_deduped` for billing, not `events_emitted`. I'll open a billing PR after we confirm the counts.
Matt: Sounds good. For the console, Lia, can you mock the new series? We should show both lines and a % delta.
Lia: Yup, will do. Expect a draft dashboard in ~30m.
Alex: PR: https://git.redwood/p/stream-proxy/merge/2481 (adds resume dedupe fallback)
Cara: Ops, please roll back canary to stable and mark incident with P2 billing risk.
OpsBot: rollback job queued -> rolling back service=stream-proxy to version=v2.14.1
Sanjay: I'll start an internal investigation ticket: INC-2025-334 with traces, route epochs, and resume token namespaces.
Cara: Thanks all. After rollback, let's run a focused canary with `dedupe_strategy=proxy-fallback` and telemetry flags on so we can validate. :+1: 
Matt: cc @billing-team in the incident so they can audit charges.
Lia: Draft dashboard link: https://dash.redwood/streams/dedup_check (will populate soon)
Cara: Closing thread for now, follow up in INC-2025-334."
